report: Customer reported the pump was not delivering water. Found the impeller was clogged with debris. Cleaned the impeller and replaced the gasket. Took about 45 minutes.
AC unit not cooling. Diagnosed a clogged air filter and dirty condenser coil. Replaced the air filter and cleaned the condenser coil. Spent 1 hour on site.
Breaker in the main panel kept tripping. The cause was a short in the lighting circuit. Repaired the damaged wiring and tested the circuit under load. Work took 2 hours.
Conveyor belt was squealing under load. Turned out the belt tension was too low. Adjusted the tensioner and lubricated the rollers. 30 mins.
Motor making a whining noise. Root cause was a worn bearing. Replaced the bearing and installed a new coupling. Total time 1.5 hours.
Control panel display was frozen. Reset the controller and reseated the ribbon cable. Display working normally afterwards. 20 minutes.
Leak at the pipe joint under the sink. Found a degraded seal on the compression fitting. Replaced the seal and tightened the fitting. Took 40 minutes.
Temperature sensor giving erratic readings. Diagnosed corrosion on the connector pins. Cleaned the connector and recalibrated the sensor. 1 hr 15 min.
Drain backing up in the kitchen. Cleared the blockage with a drain snake and flushed the line with hot water. About 50 minutes.
Device would not power on. Found a blown fuse on the supply board. Replaced the fuse and tested the unit. 25 minutes on site.
Lathe was making a grinding noise. Found the spindle bearing was worn. Replaced the belt and the bearing, then realigned the spindle. Job took 3 hours.
action: replaced the belt and the bearing

report: Water dripping from the indoor AC unit. The condensate drain line was blocked. Flushed the drain line and fitted a new drain pan. 35 min.
